name: connectwise-rmm-mcp
description: 66 ConnectWise RMM (Asio) partner API operations, plus a local fleet database, patch-compliance rollups, and script runs you can preview, schedule and watch in one command.

connectwise_rmm_client_id.title: CONNECTWISE_RMM_CLIENT_ID
connectwise_rmm_client_id.description: ConnectWise RMM (Asio) API client ID from Integrations > API Access in the ConnectWise portal. Its prefix picks the region (0e30 North America, 0e31 Europe, 0e32 Australia).

connectwise_rmm_client_secret.title: CONNECTWISE_RMM_CLIENT_SECRET
connectwise_rmm_client_secret.description: Client secret paired with the API client ID. The connector exchanges the pair for a short-lived bearer token.

connectwise_rmm_oauth_scope.title: OAuth scopes (optional)
connectwise_rmm_oauth_scope.description: Space-separated scopes to request. Leave blank to request every scope the connector uses; if your API key lacks one, the whole token request fails, so paste the line `connectwise-rmm-cli scopes` prints.

connectwise_rmm_base_url.title: API base URL (optional)
connectwise_rmm_base_url.description: Leave blank to follow the client ID's region (NA openapi.service.itsupport247.net, EU openapi.service.euplatform.connectwise.com, AU openapi.service.auplatform.connectwise.com). Set it only to pin a different host.

connectwise_rmm_token_url.title: Token URL (optional)
connectwise_rmm_token_url.description: Leave blank to mint tokens at <base URL>/v1/token for your region. Set it only if ConnectWise gives you a different token endpoint.

connectwise_rmm_user_agent.title: User-Agent header (optional)
connectwise_rmm_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on ConnectWise RMM requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own.

connectwise_rmm_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP server (optional)
connectwise_rmm_mcp_read_only.description: Set to 1 to make the MCP server read-only: it drops its write tools (run, sync; import is never an MCP tool) and refuses any non-GET API call. Leave blank for the full tool set. Preset to 1; clear it only when you want the agent to make changes.

connectwise_rmm_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token (optional)
connectwise_rmm_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote or hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile (unused - leave blank)
printing_press_client_profile.description: Leave blank. This connector registers no tenant-gated profile source, so the value is read but changes nothing; one MCP server serves the one API key it is given.
